sentences.text: Mr. Basant Singh, Advocate submitted that the present Appeal has been filed only on the ground that the Tribunal has not considered the salary certificate of the deceased, filed by the claimants.
As per the salary certificate, the salary of the deceased was Rs.8,500/- (Rupees Eight Thousand Five Hundred) per month.
However, Mr. Basant Singh, learned counsel for the appellants, has conceded that the salary certificate has not been proved in accordance with law.
5. In view of the above, no interference of this Court is called for in the impugned judgment.
The present appeal fails and deserves to be dismissed and is accordingly dismissed.
